annotations.title: Extract Document Table to Markdown & CSV

description: Extract flat 2D spreadsheet rows and columns from a single PDF or image (max 15 MB) as a Markdown table and RFC-4180 CSV without defining a JSON schema. Ideal for bank statements, credit card statements, invoice line-item grids, and timesheets. Use ONLY for flat row/column tabular exports; for nested or arbitrary JSON schemas use `extract_document_json`, and for non-tabular prose use `extract_document_text`. Fails with an error if the document contains zero tabular rows. Consumes 1 credit per page with `api_key`, or 1 of 2 free daily anonymous extractions when omitted.

api_key.description: Optional Smart OCR API key (`ocr-tok_...`). Falls back to `x-api-key` or `Authorization: Bearer` header, then to the anonymous free tier (2 documents/day per IP).

custom_headers.description: Optional ordered list of exact column headers to force in the output table (overrides `preset` default columns when provided).

file_base64.description: Base64-encoded document bytes (raw base64 or `data:<mime>;base64,...` URI, max 15 MB decoded). Mutually exclusive with `file_url` — provide exactly one.

file_name.description: Optional filename with extension (e.g., `"statement.pdf"`) for audit metadata. Defaults to `"document.pdf"`.

file_url.description: Public HTTP/HTTPS URL of the PDF, PNG, JPEG, WEBP, or TIFF document (max 15 MB). Mutually exclusive with `file_base64` — provide exactly one.

preset.description: Column normalization preset: `"bank_statement"` enforces Date/Description/Debit/Credit/Balance columns, `"invoice"` targets line-item quantity/rate/amount columns, `"receipt"` targets purchased items, and `"auto"` (default) infers headers from the grid.

name: extract_document_table

csv.description: RFC-4180 CSV representation of the extracted table ready for spreadsheet import.

headers.description: Ordered column header names of the extracted 2D table.

markdownTable.description: GitHub-flavored Markdown representation of the extracted table.

rowCount.description: Total number of extracted data rows.

rows.description: 2D array of string cell values aligned positionally with `headers`.
